gameDescriptionHtml:
In Cropia, you settle in a peaceful countryside where fertile soil, lively wildlife, and a welcoming town await. You’ll build your own farm and ranch while contributing to the growth of the community around you.

Farm & Harvest
Cultivate fertile land with a variety of crops and watch your farm grow. Arrange your fields, expand your farmland, and create a space that reflects your own farming style.

Raise & Care
Take care of animals ranging from chickens to larger livestock, ensuring they are fed and comfortable. In return, they provide valuable products and add life and charm to your farm.

Go Fishing
Spend time casting your line and experience the calm of fishing as you try to catch different kinds of fish. Each attempt brings the excitement of a new catch.

Mining
Explore the mines to collect resources that are essential for crafting and upgrading your tools and equipment.

Discover & Explore
Step outside your farm to stroll through forests, walk along the shore, or visit the bustling city. Take your time to enjoy the changing scenery and atmosphere as you explore.

Connect with the Community
Meet the townsfolk, each with their own unique personalities and needs. Build lasting friendships, sell goods, and become a valued part of the town’s daily life.
